metadata.title: Dataset of paper "Bioelectrochemically-improved anaerobic digestion of fishery processing industrial wastewater"
metadata.description: Research data documenting operation of a bioelectrochemically-improved anaerobic digester (AD-BES) processing genuine fishery processing wastewater. Supports publication in Journal of Water Process Engineering (DOI: 10.1016/j.jwpe.2024.105848).
